**Adding books**: Bookbench now brings new books onto your e-reader itself. The main copy of your books can live in a library on your computer, new books come in with a folder scheme and duplicate check, advert lines are cleaned out, and a sync keeps computer and e-reader together in both directions. This release collects 2.1-beta1 to beta3.

## New

- **Add books** (*File > Add books …*, Ctrl+I, or drag EPUB files and folders onto the window): a list with title, author, series and where each book will go. Check and change title, authors, author sort, series, number and ISBN before copying; the original file stays untouched.
- **Duplicates** are found by Calibre ID, ISBN, or title and author. Per book: *Add*, *Skip*, *Replace existing* (keeps the file name, so KOReader keeps the reading position and highlights; a backup is made first) or *Keep both*.
- **Folder scheme** with Calibre placeholders, e.g. `{author_sort}/[{series}/][{series_index:2} - ]{title}`, detected from the books you already have; change it under *Settings > Books > Library and import*. Existing books are never moved or renamed.
- **New library from e-reader** (*File* menu): copies all books of the connected e-reader into a folder on your computer with the same structure; KOReader's `.sdr` folders stay on the e-reader. The library folder gets a small `.bookbench` folder, so its settings travel with it (also in a folder synced between Windows and Linux).
- **Sync** at the top of the E-reader area: Bookbench remembers the state of every book after each sync and knows on which side a book changed. New and changed books go across in both directions; books changed on both sides are shown with their differences and left alone until you choose; deleting on the other side is offered but never checked by default. Copies keep the path, anything overwritten or deleted is backed up first. A linked e-reader opens its library on the computer when connected; the status bar and new sidebar markers show what is left to sync.
- **Remove advert text** (*Edit > Remove advert text …* or right-click a book): finds lines and links like "OceanofPDF.com" and removes them, with their container if nothing else is in it. Patterns under *Settings > Books > Advert text*.
- **Reading cache:** unchanged books are not read again when a library opens.

## Fixed

- **Metadata suggestions** (Series, Authors, Publisher, …): on Windows, typing stopped once the suggestion list had opened.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.1.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
